$comment: OTH Regensburg demo theme. PLAN §6.4: OTH branding is a THEME FILE, never hard-coded — swap this file and the same app becomes a neutral build or another university's build. Every value below was LIFTED from the live OTH stylesheet on 2026-07-30, not designed: https://www.oth-regensburg.de/typo3conf/ext/in2template/Resources/Public/Css/styles.css (probe script: temp/oth_brand_probe.py).
name: OTH Regensburg

brand.$primaryComment: OTH's own `--primary-color-base` is literally #000. Their current corporate web design is monochrome black-on-white with a single accent per page, and the colour comes from the numbered theme classes below. Do NOT invent a 'brand blue' — they do not use one.

neutrals.$comment: Lifted verbatim from the OTH stylesheet custom properties.

$accentsComment: MEASURED: OTH's stylesheet defines `.theme1 { --color-theme: #d5d2c2 }` … `.theme9 { --color-theme: #dedc00 }` — a nine-colour accent palette applied per section of their site. This is a gift for the cockpit: nine distinguishable brand-native colours map straight onto faculties, which is exactly the dimension the timetable needs to colour by. ⚠️ The mapping accent -> faculty below is OURS, not OTH's — their CSS numbers the themes but does not name them. Confirm with OTH before presenting it as their scheme.

facultyPalette.$comment: PROPOSED mapping only (see above). Kept separate from `accents` so the honest boundary stays visible.
facultyPalette.strategy: assign accents in order to the faculties present in the data, deterministic by faculty id
facultyPalette.$reserveComment: theme1 (#d5d2c2, a low-saturation sand) is reserved for 'no faculty / shared / central' rather than given to a faculty — it is the one accent that reads as neutral next to the other eight.

semantic.$comment: Cockpit state colours. NOT from the OTH palette: conflict/warning colours must never collide with a faculty colour, or a red faculty would look permanently broken.
semantic.$unknownComment: Grey means 'no data', never 'zero'. Inherited rule from Campus-Insights: a room without a calendar is grey, never 0 %.

logo.$comment: Not bundled. The OTH logo is trademarked and must be obtained from OTH (or their brand portal) before it goes into a customer-facing build. The app renders the wordmark 'Campus-Scheduler' until then.
